event_name: Date 04 July 2021 Time 20:04 2021 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 01 - 04 July 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 62) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Alleged not respecting double waved yellow flags in turn 5.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix H Article 2.5.5. b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 3 (Daniel Ricciardo), team representative and reviewed video and telemetry evidence. The Stewards accepted that the driver took the appropriate action in the double waved yellow sectors.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 3 Alleged Not Respecting Double Waved Yellow Flags
